name: RejectOrder
description: Reject a sales order. Requires both order_id and a short reason_code.

reason_code.description: Short rejection reason. PRICE_ISSUE=Price too high; OUT_OF_STOCK=Out of stock; CUSTOMER_CANCEL=Customer cancelled; WRONG_ITEM=Wrong item; DELIVERY_DATE=Delivery date issue; CREDIT_ISSUE=Credit / payment; DUPLICATE_ORDER=Duplicate order; OTHER=Other.
